chunks: Ahmad ibn Idrees, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ja‘far ibn al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn al-Waleed al-Khazzaz, from al-Waleed ibn ‘Uqbah, from al-Harith ibn Ziyad, from Shu‘ayb, from Abu Hamza, who said:

I entered upon Abu ‘Abdillah (عليه السلام), and I said to him, “Are you the master of this matter?” He said, “No.” I said, “Then your son?” He said, “No.” I said, “Then the son of your son—is it he?” He said, “No.” I said, “Then the son of the son of your son?” He said, “No.” I said, “Who is he?” He said, “The one who will fill it with justice just as it had been filled with ظلم and جور, after an interval among the Imams, just as the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله) was sent after an interval among the messengers.”

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, the divinely designated leaders from the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.صَاحِبُ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ: the divinely appointed master of this affair, referring here to the awaited Imam
key_terms.عَدْلًا: justice, establishing fairness and right order
key_terms.فَتْرَةٍ: an interval or gap between manifest missions or authorities
key_terms.يَمْلَأُهَا: he will fill it, meaning the earth will be filled by him

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by صاحب هذا الأمر in this hadith from al-Kafi, and how does Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) describe him?
ai.summary: This hadith records Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) clarifying that the صاحب هذا الأمر is not himself nor the next immediate generations mentioned by the questioner. He describes the awaited figure as the one who will fill the earth with justice after it has been filled with oppression and tyranny, and whose appearance comes after a period of interval among the Imams.
